set.body:
Type: implementation or qualification task
Plan: docs/institutional-pilot-epics.md
Assessment: docs/institutional-readiness-plan.md
Work key: C01.3
Accountable role (person unassigned): Ingestion engineer and source curator
Pilot scope: conditional; requires explicit SITE01.3 activation

Scope: Prove the actual selected import path is usable without authorizing a production cutover.
Work kind: institutional
Acceptance gate: C01 (bd-01M4W40MB0S9CQZS1C0HBYRRFT)

Acceptance criteria:
1. Import a representative permitted scope, interrupt transfer/conversion/publication and resume with exact accounting and current access.
2. Compare observed source before/after the rehearsal; every in-scope object has a successful terminal disposition or an explicitly accepted exclusion, with no unexplained omissions.
3. Curator records scientific/support limitations and a source-retention/reconciliation plan; the source is not removed or switched by completing this rehearsal.

Verification: Real-source rehearsal receipt with inventory hashes, dispositions, independent scientific review and recovery outcomes.
Expected evidence: docs/evidence/institutional-pilot/C01.3/receipt.json
Evidence must include: exact source/artifact and configuration identity; commands or human procedure and observed outcomes; fixtures/data scope and environment; acceptance-criterion results, negative cases and limitations; reviewer/acceptance evidence when the task requires institutional input.

External inputs (never assume supplied):
- Permitted source collection and curator

Starting code/evidence:
- modules/import-xnat/src/main/scala/sanctity/xnat/XnatApi.scala
- modules/import-dicom/src/main/scala/sanctity/dicom/DicomImport.scala
- docs/prd.md

Blocked by:
- C01.2: bd-01M4W5PD6CGYCTW4BNA3J1WY2P
- W01: bd-01M4W40KKEG53SX6WJ17NQVQSV
- O04: bd-01M4W40KFJVWZAM6RZ8DDH4P2D

Completion rule: satisfy every acceptance criterion with observed evidence. Failed or not-run requirements stay open. Preserve scientific identity/history and current authority; create blocking remediation work for discovered scope. Automated or simulated evidence cannot replace a required institutional or human result. No implementation is claimed by this plan.
Deferred scope is not completion. Do not start conditional implementation merely because it appears in mote ready.
